verdict.rationale: Plausible's core design avoids collecting personal data and requires no consent banner, and the open-source Community Edition can be fully self-hosted so no data leaves the user's own infrastructure — a strong proxy for 'opting out' of vendor-side tracking. However, there is no explicit documentation of a telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out toggle for the product itself (e.g., anonymous usage stats phoning home from CE), so the fit is inferred rather than directly evidenced.
